mist-flower-corolla.name: Mist Flower Corolla
mist-flower-corolla.description: A common material gathered from Mist Flowers.

flaming-flower-stamen.name: Flaming Flower Stamen
flaming-flower-stamen.description: A common material gathered from Flaming Flowers.

electro-crystal.name: Electro Crystal
electro-crystal.description: A crystal rich with Electro energy.
sources: Found at the base of mountain cliffs

butterfly-wings.name: Butterfly Wings
butterfly-wings.description: Brightly colored wings gathered from butterflies.

frog.name: Frog
frog.description: A small frog often found in damp places.

luminescent-spine.name: Luminescent Spine
luminescent-spine.description: A light-emitting spine gathered from fireflies.
sources: Found in the wild at night

lizard-tail.name: Lizard Tail
lizard-tail.description: A curled tail dropped by lizards.

loach-pearl.name: Loach Pearl
loach-pearl.description: A shining pearl spat out by a loach.

pluie-lotus.name: Pluie Lotus
pluie-lotus.description: A lotus that grows in rainy and humid environments.

cacahuatl.name: Cacahuatl
cacahuatl.description: A crop rich in flavor. The fleshy part itself features a unique bitterness and its seeds, after being fermented and baked, can be made into other delicacies.
sources: Found in the wild in Natlan

embercore-flower.name: Embercore Flower
embercore-flower.description: A strange flower that can be found all over the plains and highlands. Mature buds will bloom after being hit.
sources: Found in the wild in Natlan

icy-pebble.name: Icy Pebble
icy-pebble.description: A pebble commonly found on Nod-Krai's coasts, characterized by a naturally occurring hollow. Touching it sends a faint chill through your finger.

nocturnal-blossom.name: Nocturnal Blossom
nocturnal-blossom.description: A flower that blooms at night. Its petals give off a faint fragrance in the moonlight.

horsetail.name: Horsetail
horsetail.description: A purple plant that sometimes grows amidst Silvergrass but grows taller, straighter, and plumper - like an aristocrat among the paupers.
